prompts.title: Foundation — Data Structures and Engine Init
structs_added: appvars_t (fields: state, tick, timerSecs, lastTickSec, angerLevel, lastAngerTick, angerPending, roundNumber, penaltyBombType, board[24], boardAnger[24])
functions_added: on_init (initializes engine, sets black background, zeros all vars and board arrays)
enums_added: GameState (STATE_TITLE, STATE_PLAYING, STATE_PASS_PROMPT, STATE_PASSING, STATE_NEXT_CONFIRM, STATE_WIN, STATE_LOSE, STATE_PAUSE)
prompts.notes: Black background on all 24 screens. Engine initialized. All data structures in place.

prompts.title: Title Screen — Static Layout
functions_added: showLabel(appObject_t* label, bool show) - toggles label+child glyph visibility
initTitleScreen() - creates BOMBCUBE and TAP TO START labels on OCT_PLANE_FRONT
startGame() - hides title labels, sets STATE_PLAYING, calls initBoard()
prompts.notes: Title screen: BOMBCUBE at y=60 (FONT_1), TAP TO START at y=180 (FONT_2), both on FRONT face. Tap any face from STATE_TITLE calls startGame(). startGame() now also calls initBoard().

prompts.title: Bomb Placement — Static Board
functions_added: initBoard() - deletes existing bomb sprites, builds shuffled 22-type array (Fisher-Yates + OCT_random), resets board[24] and boardAnger[24], places 22 OCT_add sprites on quads 2..23 with twistable=true and BMP_001 placeholder
prompts.notes: 22 bomb sprites on quads 2..23. Service quads 0 and 1 remain empty. Each of 11 bomb types appears exactly twice. Fisher-Yates shuffle using OCT_random(0, i+1). XSIGN/YSIGN used as system globals (not redeclared). initBoard() called from startGame() after STATE_PLAYING is set.

prompts.title: Twist — Detect Row of 8 Quads
functions_added: getRowForTwist(int twid, int row[8]) - normalizes half-twists via OCT_TWIST_HALF, copies from TWIST_ROWS lookup table
data_added: static const TWIST_ROWS[12][8] - 12 twist directions mapped to 8 quad IDs each. TOP↔FRONT, FRONT↔RIGHT, RIGHT↔BACK, BACK↔LEFT, LEFT↔BOTTOM, BOTTOM↔TOP pairs
prompts.notes: on_twisted: early return if not STATE_PLAYING; stores disconnected_ms in lastTwistMs; calls getRowForTwist; logs 8 quad IDs via OCT_trace. TWIST_ROWS is static const NOT TL global. Half-twists (twid >= OCT_TWIST_HALF) use same row as full twist counterpart.

prompts.title: Twist — Slide Bombs Along Row (2048 Style)
functions_added: getBombAtQuad(int quadId) -> appObject_t* — iterates gObjects[1..], returns bomb at quadId or NULL

slideBombs(int row[8]) — 2048-style: reads slots[8]+angerSlots[8], compacts both toward index 7, deletes old sprites, recreates at new positions with correct bombType/anger/quadIndex, updates boardAnger[]
prompts.notes: slideBombs called from on_twisted for full twists only (twid < OCT_TWIST_HALF). Fix applied: anger state (boardAnger[]) is now correctly carried with bombs to new positions using parallel angerSlots[]/angerResult[] arrays. Empty positions get ANGER_CALM. 1 fix cycle needed (boardAnger carry-forward was missing initially).

prompts.title: Twist — Half-Twist Partial Slide
modified_functions: slideBombs(int row[8], int shiftAmount) — added shiftAmount param; shiftAmount==4: existing compaction; shiftAmount==2: cyclic shift (i+2)%8 with boardAnger carried
prompts.notes: Forward declaration updated: slideBombs(int row[8], int shiftAmount). on_twisted: full twists call slideBombs(row,4); half-twists call slideBombs(row,2). Both paths update vars.boardAnger[] correctly.

prompts.title: Merge Detection — Find Matching Adjacent Pairs
functions_added: checkMergeInRow(int row[8]) -> int — scans pairs from index 6 down to 0; on type match: sets ANGER_LOVED on keptQuad, OCT_del removedQuad sprite, checks win (22 quads merged=STATE_WIN else STATE_PASS_PROMPT), returns keptQuad; returns -1 if no match
prompts.notes: on_twisted calls checkMergeInRow(row) after slideBombs(row,4) for full twists only. Win check: count quads 2..23 where board[q]==-1 OR boardAnger[q]==ANGER_LOVED; if 22 -> STATE_WIN. Minor: boardAnger[removedQuad] not explicitly reset to ANGER_CALM (non-functional — board[q]==-1 is sufficient for win check).

prompts.title: Bomb Visual States — Display Anger Per Bomb
functions_added: updateBombVisual(int quadId) — looks up BMP_BOMB[bombType][anger], calls OCT_sequence(obj, bmpId, bmpId, 0, OCT_SEQ_REFRESH)
data_added: static const BMP_BOMB[11][4] — all 11 bomb types × 4 anger states → BMP_001..004 placeholders. Requires 44 real sprite assets.
prompts.notes: updateBombVisual() called from initBoard() after each bomb is placed, and from checkMergeInRow() after keptBomb gets ANGER_LOVED. Prompt 7 minor fix applied: boardAnger[removedQuad]=ANGER_CALM now added in checkMergeInRow().

prompts.title: Anger System — Fast Twist Detection
functions_added: triggerExplosion() — stub: sets vars.state = STATE_LOSE (full implementation in Prompt 11)

triggerAngerEvent() — (a) checks if any bomb is FURIOUS → calls triggerExplosion(); (b) increments boardAnger for all non-LOVED non-empty quads 2..23, updates obj->anger and calls updateBombVisual(); (c) sets lastAngerTick=tick, angerPending=true
prompts.notes: on_twisted: after slide/merge processing, if lastTwistMs < TWIST_FAST_MS call triggerAngerEvent() — applies to BOTH full and half twists. FURIOUS check happens BEFORE escalation loop. lastTwistMs is set from disconnected_ms before the check, so init value of 0 is overwritten before first use.

prompts.title: Anger System — Accelerometer Shake During Pass
prompts.notes: on_tick() STATE_PASSING: reads OCT_TM_gravity x/y/n, Manhattan mag, delta>1.5f → triggerAngerEvent(). prevGravMag updated each tick.

prompts.title: Explosion — Chain Reaction and State Transition
functions_added: triggerExplosion() — full: STATE_LOSE + explosionStep=0 + explosionStartTick=tick
prompts.notes: on_tick() STATE_LOSE: step=(tick-explosionStartTick)/2, step<22 → OCT_sequence on bomb at quad(step+2) with BMP_002..BMP_004 placeholder animation.

prompts.title: Pass System — PASS_PROMPT State and Button
functions_added: showPassButton(bool visible) — creates/hides 'PASS!' label at OCT_PLANE_TOP quad 1
prompts.notes: checkMergeInRow() calls showPassButton(true) on STATE_PASS_PROMPT. on_tap() STATE_PASS_PROMPT+TOP → showPassButton(false)+STATE_PASSING+prevGravMag=1.0f.

prompts.title: Pass System — Penalty Twist and Next Player Confirm
prompts.notes: on_twisted(): STATE_PASS_PROMPT → triggerExplosion()+return; not STATE_PLAYING/PASSING → return; STATE_PASSING → return. on_tap(): STATE_PASSING+side face → STATE_PLAYING.

prompts.title: Timer — Countdown Display
functions_added: initTimer()
updateTimerDisplay()
prompts.notes: timer countdown at OCT_PLANE_TOP quad 0. OCT_1SEC_TICKS decrement. triggerExplosion() at 0. Called from startGame().

prompts.title: Win Condition — Final Check and WIN State
functions_added: resetGame() — round=0, reinit board, STATE_PLAYING
prompts.notes: on_tap STATE_WIN → resetGame(). Win check already in checkMergeInRow().

prompts.title: Round System — Track Penalty Bomb Per Round
functions_added: startNewRound() — roundNumber++, penaltyBombType, applies ANGRY/FURIOUS to penalty bombs
prompts.notes: on_tap STATE_LOSE+explosionStep>=21 → startNewRound(). Round 2+ → penalty bomb ANGRY, Round 3+ → FURIOUS.

prompts.title: Calm Down — Per-Bomb Anger Over Time
prompts.notes: triggerAngerEvent() sets angerTick[quad]=tick. on_tick() STATE_PLAYING: if tick-angerTick>=CALM_TICKS: boardAnger--, updateBombVisual().

prompts.title: Calm Meter UI — Stress Indicator
functions_added: initCalmMeter()
updateCalmMeter() — CALM/NERVOUS/DANGER!
prompts.notes: on_tick updates every OCT_1SEC_TICKS/2 during STATE_PLAYING. showPassButton toggles calm meter visibility.

prompts.title: Game Over and Win Screens
functions_added: showWinScreen() — DEFUSED!+CUBE SAFE! labels on FRONT
showLoseScreen() — BOOM!+TAP RETRY labels on FRONT
prompts.notes: on_tick shows each once via winShown/loseShown flags. Fix applied: both labels tracked correctly. resetGame/startNewRound reset flags.

prompts.title: Title and Pause Screens
prompts.notes: BOTTOM tap from PLAYING/PASS_PROMPT → STATE_PAUSE + PAUSED label. Any tap from PAUSE → STATE_PLAYING. Fix: pause check moved before STATE_PASS_PROMPT handler.
